name: GDELT-tone dive with fear crash on 4h (macro-driven intraday flush, long)
rationale: MECHANISM: fuses the macro-regime and velocity ideas on a fast clock. A sharp DIVE in gdelt_tone (broad macro fear spilling in) crossing down through a fitted level, confirmed by fear_greed also breaking down and a same-window 4h price drop (ret_Nd), marks a macro-driven intraday flush — forced, non-crypto-specific selling that historically snaps back once traders realize the macro headline does not change crypto fundamentals. Distinct from the 1d gdelt-gated contrarian (hh-16, a slow regime gate) because here gdelt_tone is a fast TRIGGER, and distinct from crypto-native velocity specs because the panic source is macro. Long the snapback; exit when tone or fear relieves, or stop/TP/time. DISCONFIRMER: must clear REAL 4h round-trip fees (edge < 2x cost => mirage; kill). If the gdelt dive carries no independent sign once you control for the fear break and the price drop, gdelt_tone adds nothing — kill. Verify gdelt_tone updates fast enough at the 4h horizon to be a same-flush trigger, not a lagging confirmer.
catalyst: a macro-tone dive and fear crash into a 4h price flush
